clauses.condition_explanation: Distribution is permitted only subject to the stated limit on what may be distributed and the requirement that Software derivatives be distributed under this License, including its Notice provision.

clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is any one of the listed activities; the recipient then becomes a Licensee and is subject to the License terms.

clauses.clause_label: 7.1 Violations of Ethical Standards or Breaching Duty of Care
clauses.scope_note: If the stated violation or breach occurs, the Licensee must remedy the violation or harm caused by the Licensee within 30 days of notification. Failure makes all rights in the Software granted by this License null and void as between Licensor and Licensee.
clauses.condition_explanation: The 30-day remedy duty is triggered by an Ethical Standards violation by the Licensee, or a Duty of Care breach by the Licensee or an entity in the upstream Supply Chain before the good or service reaches the Licensee. The rights consequence applies if the Licensee fails to remedy within the stated period.

clauses.scope_note: The Licensee can keep the License by taking all practical steps to comply with the Notice section within 30 days after written notice of noncompliance. Otherwise the License and all rights granted under it end immediately.
clauses.condition_explanation: Retention of rights is conditional on practical compliance steps within the cure period; failure to meet that condition terminates the License.

clauses.scope_note: Upon the specified finding, all rights granted to the Licensee by this License terminate immediately.
clauses.condition_explanation: The termination is triggered by a finding by a court or other legally authorized adjudicating body that the Licensee committed actions violating the Ethical Standards or Supply Chain Impacted Party sections.

clauses.scope_note: Filing the specified patent litigation terminates the patent license and all other rights granted under this License as of the filing date. The litigation may concern the Software, all or part of its code, or a derivative work developed using the Software, including a portion of its code.
clauses.condition_explanation: Termination is triggered when the Licensee institutes patent litigation against any entity alleging direct or contributory patent infringement by the specified Software or Software-derived material; cross-claims and counterclaims are included.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to modified software, source code, or other derivative work. The entire covered work must be licensed under the exact same conditions as this License.
